rules.title: Dynamic Python evaluation
rules.description: eval() executes attacker-controlled expressions when its input is not trusted.
rules.remediation: Replace with a constrained parser or explicit allow-list.

rules.title: Dynamic Python execution
rules.description: exec() executes arbitrary Python source.
rules.remediation: Remove dynamic execution; dispatch through explicit functions.

rules.title: Shell-enabled subprocess
rules.description: shell=True can turn untrusted values into shell commands.
rules.remediation: Pass an argument list with shell=False and validate inputs.

rules.title: Unsafe Python deserialization
rules.description: pickle can execute code while loading untrusted data.
rules.remediation: Use JSON or a schema-validated data format.

rules.title: Unsafe YAML load
rules.description: yaml.load without SafeLoader can construct unsafe objects.
rules.remediation: Use yaml.safe_load or SafeLoader.

rules.title: TLS verification disabled
rules.description: Disabling certificate verification permits machine-in-the-middle attacks.
rules.remediation: Verify certificates and install the required CA.

rules.title: Shell eval
rules.description: eval reinterprets data as shell source.
rules.remediation: Avoid eval; use arrays and fixed command dispatch.

rules.title: Remote script piped to shell
rules.description: Piping a network response directly into a shell executes unreviewed remote content.
rules.remediation: Download, verify a pinned checksum/signature, then execute deliberately.

rules.title: Dangerous recursive deletion
rules.description: A recursive forced deletion targets a root-like path.
rules.remediation: Use a validated, explicit non-root path and guard variables.

rules.title: World-writable permission
rules.description: chmod 777 grants write access to every local user.
rules.remediation: Use least-privilege modes such as 750 or 640.

rules.title: Terraform public network exposure
rules.description: A security group or firewall rule permits all IPv4 addresses.
rules.remediation: Restrict source CIDRs to required networks.

rules.title: Terraform public ACL
rules.description: A Terraform ACL is configured as publicly readable or writable.
rules.remediation: Use private ACLs and explicit, least-privilege policies.

rules.title: Terraform TLS verification disabled
rules.description: Provider TLS certificate checks are disabled.
rules.remediation: Enable certificate validation and configure a trusted CA.

rules.title: Terraform hardcoded secret
rules.description: A likely secret is embedded directly in infrastructure code.
rules.remediation: Read secrets from a managed secret store or protected variable.

rules.title: Ansible shell module
rules.description: shell module commands are susceptible to injection and quoting errors.
rules.remediation: Use command module with argv where shell features are unnecessary.

rules.title: Ansible errors ignored
rules.description: ignore_errors can conceal failed security controls or deployment steps.
rules.remediation: Handle expected failures explicitly with failed_when.

rules.title: Ansible TLS verification disabled
rules.description: Certificate validation is disabled in an Ansible task.
rules.remediation: Enable validation and supply the appropriate CA.

rules.title: Ansible world-writable file
rules.description: A task sets a world-writable file mode.
rules.remediation: Use least-privilege file modes.

rules.title: AWS access key identifier
rules.description: An AWS access key identifier was added.
rules.remediation: Revoke the key immediately and use environment or workload credentials.

rules.title: Private key material
rules.description: A private key marker was added.
rules.remediation: Remove and rotate the key; store it in a secret manager.

rules.title: Authentication guard removed
rules.description: An authentication guard was removed from a changed line.
rules.remediation: Confirm the endpoint remains protected by an equivalent control.
